title: WHEN PRESSURE MOUNTS
PSALM 16:8 COVENANT PRAYER
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering

scenes.a: Your steps feel unsteady under this sudden pressure.
I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
scenes.sub: HE IS AT MY RIGHT HAND

scenes.a: Lord God, keep my eyes fixed on Your holy presence today.
Guard my thoughts against every storm and steady my footing on Your truth.
Be my strong anchor so no wave can shake me from Your peace.
Strengthen my resolve to walk upright, secure under Your unyielding shield.

captions: Your steps feel unsteady under this sudden pressure.
Scripture assures us in Psalm 16 verse 8:
I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
Lord God, keep my eyes fixed on Your holy presence today.
When circumstances shift and fear tries to sway my heart, stand beside me.
Guard my thoughts against every storm and steady my footing on Your truth.
Be my strong anchor so no wave can shake me from Your peace.
Strengthen my resolve to walk upright, secure under Your unyielding shield.
Amen. When your steps feel unsteady under sudden pressure.
